novels.author: Sky Demon Order
novels.title: The Former Slave Who Awakened to the Strongest Class [Shadow Necromancer] Exacts Revenge on This Corrupt World! (WN)
novels.description:
This is the story of a slave boy who becomes the strongest and takes revenge on the entire world.
Sid Ranorus, a slave who serves as the pack mule for the Hero’s Party.
Sid was a [Necromancer], but he was a worthless class whose spells had no effect against monsters stronger than himself.
Though he was mistreated by the Hero’s Party—a bunch of jerks—he did his job with all his might, but—
“This is your final order, Sid. Act as bait and lure the Minotaur.”
“Wait! Don’t leave me behind! Everyone!”
—While conquering an S-rank dungeon, he was forced to act as bait by the hero’s party and left behind.
“Damn it… I want… revenge…!”
Just as he accepted his death, Sid cast Necromancy on himself, successfully becoming an Undead and escaping death.
Furthermore, he awakened as a [Shadow Necromancer], one of the strongest classes.
“Well, well, well—I’ve lived quite a long time, but it seems I won’t be bored even after death.”
Having recruited the legendary vampire—the boss of the S-rank dungeon—as an ally, Sid resolved to take revenge on the Hero’s party.
Leveling up, earning money, and recruiting monsters as allies with his Shadow Necromancer powers—all to deal a gruesome death to the Hero Party that abandoned him.
Eventually, Sid would come to know the truth about the world—and he would swear an oath.
To take revenge on the entire world.
